leadText: (Japanese: げきとう! ポケモンリーグ!! Fierce Battles! Pokémon League!!) is the third and final episode in a series of three clip shows released as OVAs in 2000 called Pocket Monsters TV Special: Arc Recap, available on rental-only VHS. They chronicled the events of throughout 's Indigo League journey. This episode is entirely made up of clips from the Indigo Plateau Conference, showing select events from Round One - Begin! to Friends to the End. Like the second episode, but unlike the first, the episode does not have any footage previously exclusive to TV clipshows or Dare Da? eyecatches. Segments are occasionally broken up by Team Rocket's exploits during the conference.
